title: EIP-8369: VOPS Profiles for FOCIL Eligibility
description: Describes VOPS profiles that a future FOCIL extension could use to determine which transactions receive inclusion enforcement.
author: Thomas Thiery (@soispoke)
laymanDescription: Inclusion lists only work if every node can cheaply agree on whether a skipped transaction was genuinely invalid. Ordinary transactions are easy to check; account abstraction transactions can depend on almost any state. This document maps out which transactions are cheap enough to enforce, without setting any rules itself.
benefits: One shared eligibility boundary stops nodes agreeing on a list but disagreeing on enforcement
Checking each omission at one claimed index replaces an append loop that was quadratic
Any includer can classify a candidate without first obtaining a witness
tradeoffs: The builder picks the index, so a transaction is protected only if valid at every choice
Transactions whose validity depends on a predecessor in the same block get the weaker guarantee
Every binding rule and constant must be restated in a future Standards Track EIP
